# Graphs That Tell the Truth

Version 1.13.2 makes the history behind the graphs more reliable: no more invented lines, no blank graphs after a failed fetch, and no slowdown on long time windows.

## The graphs

- **No line before the first recorded state.** For a young entity, or a window that reaches back beyond what the recorder keeps, the graph used to draw a flat line at the first value across the whole missing stretch. That stretch is now left empty, so the line starts where the data starts.
- **Very long windows no longer freeze the page.** A window such as a year with 60 points per hour produced about 525,000 buckets and blocked the browser for seconds. The card now coarsens the point spacing once a window would exceed 10,000 buckets. A year at one point per hour still keeps its full resolution.

## Fixes

- **A failed history request keeps the graphs.** When Home Assistant did not answer a history request, every graph went blank until the next update. The card now keeps the last successful history on screen.
- **A late answer no longer overwrites a newer one.** If the history for an outdated window or configuration arrived after the history for the current one, it replaced it. Late answers are now dropped, including when the entity list has become empty.

Dependencies are updated.

## Upgrading

Nothing to do after updating. Existing cards keep their configuration and pick up the fixes on the next reload.
